title: code-viz tour (Explain mode), version 1
description: One guided walkthrough of one code-viz example. Source: <course repo>/codeviz/tours/<id>.json (default tour) or <id>--<name>.json (named tour); `code-viz build` validates it and publishes it to viz/tours/. Field names follow VS Code CodeTour where they overlap (title, description, steps[].title, steps[].description, steps[].line). No timings. Manual: `code-viz readme`, section 22.

example.description: The labeled example's id (the <!-- run: id=... --> or notebook id).

name.description: Tour name when an example has more than one (file <id>--<name>.json; URL &tour=<name>). Omitted for the default tour.

description.description: One or two sentences shown before the first step.

reviewed.description: true only after Bill has read and checked the tour. Drafts stay false; the viewer marks unreviewed tours.

source.description: Who drafted it, for example 'draft: omp llmproxy flagship free' or 'Bill'.

lines.description: 1-based line ranges of the example's code, for example '1-4,9'.

kind.description: reveal: show these lines (added to the lines already shown); focus: highlight these lines and dim the rest; predict: ask, the answer shows on Reveal answer or the next step; run: show the code's state at a step of its Run-mode trace; stage: switch the code to another labeled block (build-up), animating only the changed lines.

description.description: The callout text (CodeTour's field name). `note` is accepted as an alias in sources.

line.description: CodeTour's single line; same as lines: 'N'.

question.description: predict: the question students answer before the next step.

answer.description: predict: the answer the class is steered toward.

trace_step.description: run: the Run-mode step (0-based, as ?step=N) to show; switching to Run mode lands there.

stage.description: stage: the id of the labeled block whose code is shown from this step on.
